title: Garrison / Agents
description: Per-agent view: invocations, run time, queue, claim, startup, TTFT, streaming, delegation, tokens, cost, outcomes, guard trips, and tool calls.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.description: Tenant ID. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: harness
list.label: Harness
list.description: Harness type. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.description: Served model as the harness reported it; none when it did not report one.

list.name: window
list.label: Average over
list.description: Window for rates, averages, and percentiles. Runs are infrequent, so short windows leave gaps.

panels.title: Invocations by agent (per minute)
panels.description: Runs created per minute, by agent.

targets.expr: sum by (agent) (rate(garrison_runs_created_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Invocations by agent in the selected range
panels.description: Runs created per agent.

targets.expr: round(sum by (agent) (increase(garrison_runs_created_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness"}[$__range]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Invocations by deployment
panels.description: Runs created per agent and deployment.

targets.expr: round(sum by (agent, deployment) (increase(garrison_runs_created_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness"}[$__range]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Run time by agent (queued to completed)
panels.description: Total run time percentiles per agent. Exemplar dots open the run trace.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="total", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="total", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="total", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Execution time by agent
panels.description: Harness process start to exit, per agent.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="execution", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="execution", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="execution", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Queue time by agent
panels.description: Queued to leased, per agent.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="queue", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="queue", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Claim and compile time by agent (p95)
panels.description: Scheduler claim and execution spec compile inside the lease request, per agent.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="claim", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="compile", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Startup time by agent (leased to harness start)
panels.description: Workspace preparation, MCP pre-flight, and process start, per agent.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="startup", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="startup", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Time to first token by agent
panels.description: Harness start to first model output, per agent.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="first_token", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="first_token", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="first_token", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Time to first token excluding delegation
panels.description: TTFT minus the time spent waiting on delegated runs before the first output.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="first_token_excl_delegation", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="first_token_excl_delegation", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Streaming time by agent
panels.description: First to last model output, per agent.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="streaming", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="streaming", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Delegation wait by agent
panels.description: Time a run spent waiting on runs it delegated to (only runs that delegated).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="delegation_wait", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="delegation_wait", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Average stage time by agent
panels.description: Mean of each stage per agent over the averaging window.

targets.expr: sum by (agent, stage) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_sum{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window])) / clamp_min(sum by (agent, stage) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_count{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window])), 1e-9) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Tokens by agent and direction (per minute)
panels.description: Input, output, cached, and reasoning tokens per minute, by agent.

targets.expr: sum by (agent, direction) (rate(garrison_run_tokens_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Cost by agent (USD per hour)
panels.description: Reported or estimated cost per hour, by agent.

targets.expr: sum by (agent) (rate(garrison_run_cost_usd_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window])) * 3600 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Outcomes by agent (per minute)
panels.description: Finished runs per minute, by agent and outcome.

targets.expr: sum by (agent, outcome) (rate(garrison_runs_finished_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Outcomes by agent
panels.description: Finished runs per agent and outcome in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum by (agent, outcome) (increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Guard trips by agent and guard
panels.description: Runs stopped by a guard (repetition, no_progress, output_limit, timeout, blocked) on the control plane.

targets.expr: sum by (agent, guard) (increase(garrison_runs_guard_trips_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Guard trips seen by workers
panels.description: Runs workers stopped with a guard, by agent and guard.

targets.expr: sum by (agent, guard) (increase(garrison_worker_run_guard_trips_total{agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Tool calls per run by agent
panels.description: Median and 95th percentile tool calls (MCP tools, shell commands, searches) per run.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_tool_calls_bucket{agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_tool_calls_bucket{agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Schema validations and repairs by agent
panels.description: Invalid structured output and repair attempts per agent.

targets.expr: sum by (agent) (increase(garrison_runs_schema_validations_total{result="invalid", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")
sum by (agent) (increase(garrison_runs_repairs_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Agent summary
panels.description: Per-agent totals over the selected range: runs, success rate, run time and TTFT percentiles, tokens, and cost.

targets.expr: round(sum by (agent) (increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

(sum by (agent) (increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{outcome="Succeeded", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) or sum by (agent) (increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) * 0) / clamp_min(sum by (agent) (increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])), 1)

histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="total", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="total", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, agent) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="first_token", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])))

round(sum by (agent) (increase(garrison_run_tokens_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))) or sum by (agent) (increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) * 0

sum by (agent) (increase(garrison_run_cost_usd_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) or sum by (agent) (increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) * 0

panels.title: Slowest agent runs
panels.description: Run traces for the selected agents, slowest first.

panels.title: Agent logs
panels.description: Lines that name the selected agents.

targets.expr: {app="garrison"} |~ "agent=${agent:regex}" |~ "tenant=${tenant:regex}"
